metadata.article_title: Persons not to be deprived of property save by authority of law

article.title: Persons not to be deprived of property save by authority of law
article.content:
300APersons not to be deprived of property save by authority of law

Article 300A · Part XII
No person shall be deprived of his property save by authority of law.

1 Ins. by the Constitution (Forty-fourth Amendment) Act, 1978, s. 34 (w.e.f. 20-6-1979).
